tasks.description: The catalog is the foundation of the store. Merchants must be able to create, edit, and delete products. Each product has a name, description, one or more images, a price, a SKU, and a category.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant account, when creating a new product, then the product is added to the catalog.
Given a merchant account, when editing a product, then the product details are updated in the catalog.
Given a merchant account, when deleting a product, then the product is removed from the catalog.

tasks.description: Customers must be able to search the catalog by keyword against product names and descriptions. Search results must be filterable by category, by price range, and sortable by price and by newest.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search query, when searching the catalog, then relevant products are returned.
Given a search query, when filtering by category, then only products in the selected category are returned.
Given a search query, when sorting by price, then products are returned in the correct order.

tasks.description: Customers add products to a shopping cart. The cart persists across sessions for logged-in users. Customers can update the quantity of any line item or remove a line item entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when adding a product to the cart, then the product is added to the cart.
Given a logged-in user, when updating the quantity of a line item, then the quantity is updated in the cart.
Given a logged-in user, when removing a line item, then the line item is removed from the cart.

tasks.description: From the cart, a customer proceeds to checkout. Checkout collects a shipping address and a billing address, shows an order summary including shipping cost and total, and requires the customer to be authenticated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when proceeding to checkout, then the shipping address and billing address are collected.
Given a logged-in user, when viewing the order summary, then the shipping cost and total are displayed.
Given a logged-in user, when completing checkout, then the order is created.

tasks.description: The platform calculates a shipping cost for an order based on the destination address and the total order weight.
acceptance_criteria: Given a destination address and order weight, when calculating shipping cost, then the correct shipping cost is returned.

tasks.description: Payment is processed through Stripe. During checkout, after the order summary, the customer enters card details and the platform charges the order total via Stripe.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer, when entering card details, then the payment is processed through Stripe.
Given a customer, when the payment is successful, then the order is updated to a paid state.

tasks.description: When payment succeeds, the platform creates an order record capturing the line items, addresses, shipping cost, and total. Customers can view their order history and the status of each order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when creating an order record, then the order record is created.
Given a customer, when viewing order history, then the order history is displayed.
Given a customer, when viewing order status, then the order status is displayed.

tasks.description: Each product tracks an available stock quantity. When an order is placed, the stock for each purchased product is decremented.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when updating the stock quantity, then the stock quantity is updated.
Given an order, when placing the order, then the stock quantity for each product is decremented.

tasks.description: After an order is successfully paid, the platform sends the customer an email receipt containing the order number, line items, totals, and shipping address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful payment, when sending an email receipt, then the email receipt is sent to the customer.

tasks.description: Customers who have purchased a product may leave a star rating and a written review on that product's detail page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer, when leaving a review, then the review is displayed on the product detail page.
Given a customer, when leaving a rating, then the rating is displayed on the product detail page.

tasks.description: Logged-in customers can add products to a personal wishlist and remove them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in customer, when adding a product to the wishlist, then the product is added to the wishlist.
Given a logged-in customer, when removing a product from the wishlist, then the product is removed from the wishlist.

tasks.description: Merchants access an admin panel to manage the store. The admin panel provides product management, category management, order management, and inventory visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Given a merchant, when accessing the admin panel, then the admin panel is displayed.
Given a merchant, when managing products, then the products can be created, edited, and deleted.
Given a merchant, when managing categories, then the categories can be created, edited, and deleted.

tasks.description: The product detail page shows all product information and images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when viewing the product detail page, then the product information and images are displayed.

tasks.description: Categories form the browsable structure of the storefront.
acceptance_criteria: Given a category, when creating a new category, then the category is created.
Given a category, when editing a category, then the category is updated.

tasks.description: Merchants can update an order's status.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order, when updating the order status, then the order status is updated.

tasks.description: Merchants can view inventory levels.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when viewing inventory levels, then the inventory levels are displayed.

tasks.description: Products can have one or more images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product, when uploading an image, then the image is uploaded successfully.

tasks.description: The platform uses a database to store product information and order data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a database, when migrating to a new database, then the data is migrated successfully.

tasks.description: The platform provides an API for merchants to access product information and order data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API, when accessing the API documentation, then the documentation is displayed.

tasks.description: Categories form a hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: Given a category, when creating a new category, then the category is added to the hierarchy.
